entries.text: This scan found 20 issues on 20 elements across 5 pages, and all of them are critical or serious (3 critical, 17 serious). Fix the social icon links in the shared footer first (src/Shell.jsx, footer.site-footer social links, lines 30-32): each one wraps a hidden icon and carries no text or label, so screen readers announce nothing a visitor can act on. That markup is shared, so one fix there clears all 15 of those at once. Next, the low-contrast text on two pages, then the image with no description, the unlabelled form field and the unnamed dropdown.
